description: Source timestamps and DD/MM/YYYY text become real dates; TIMESTAMPTZ is read as Karachi local time; unparseable dates are rejected as R03
Trim spaces; branch text compared in upper case without dots and hyphens
Inventory category: trim + case-insensitive match to the 8 canonical names, else Not recorded
Boxes to selling units: boxes_received x strips_per_box
Tablets to selling units: tablets_on_hand / tablets_per_strip
REAL cost to 2 decimals; every amount rounded to 2 decimals (NUMERIC(14,2))
USD amount x Finance USD/PKR rate on or before the GRN date; PKR rate = 1; no rate means reject R06
Till code / vendor code / item_id to canonical product code P-0<item_id> (exact, rule, description, manual)
Typed branch text / branch_id / store_code to canonical store_code (exact, rule, alias list)
Card number / typed panel name / account to L-<number> or PANEL-<account>; walk-in to WALKIN; unresolved to Unknown (-1) with a flag
One reason code per invalid line, checked in order R07, R03, R05, R01, R02, R04, R06; invalid lines go to etl.rejects
Exact duplicate = same source key twice; first kept, others counted. Same customer/item/day on a new line key is kept
gross = qty x price; net = gross - discount; margin = net - cost
cost_amount_pkr = qty x Inventory standard cost effective on the receipt date (cost history)
VOIDED receipts and CANCELLED GRNs stay in the facts with is_cancelled = true; views exclude them
Surrogate keys: product_key = item_id, supplier_key = supplier_id; branch and customer keys given once and never renumbered; -1 Unknown, 0 Walk-in
dim_date generated 2023-11-01..2027-01-31; fiscal year Jul-Jun; Ramadan flag from config/ramadan_dates.csv
Every fact row keeps source_system, source_key and batch_id
